explained.summary:
His father died when Marcus was very young, so what he learned came from the man’s reputation and the way the family remembered him: modesty and a quiet, steady strength of character.

It’s a reminder that people keep teaching after they’ve gone. The stories told about someone can shape a child as much as the person ever could.
